control.name: CONTROL — Marked never honours a marker (the pre-#1805 legacy lift)

mutations.name: an unescaped dollar no longer taints the cell (a marker inside inline math is honoured)
raw HTML / links no longer taint the cell (a marker in an HTML comment is honoured)
a backslash no longer escapes (an escaped dollar or bracket taints the cell)
a non-plain cell still honours its marker
SR-1808-1 rr4: an escaped dollar no longer taints the cell (spaced escaped dollars honour the marker)
SR-1808-1 rr4: a character reference no longer taints the cell (spaced reference dollars honour the marker)
SR-1808-1 rr4: a span opener fused to the prose before it no longer taints the cell (an autolink-glued marker is honoured)
SR-1808-1 rr4: the marker opener need not follow whitespace (a paren-led marker is honoured)
SR-1808-1 rr4: the marker closer need not stand clear (a marker glued to the text after it is honoured)
SR-1808-1 rr4 over-taint: a `(` no longer allowed before a span opener (a parenthesised mention taints the cell)
SR-1808-1 rr4 over-taint: plain punctuation after the marker closer no longer allowed
CR-1808-4: Marked stops at the first good marker (a later marker not set apart is never checked)
#2684: CommentOnly never matches (a lone heading span lifts as a passing command)
#2684 review S1: CommentLed judges the whole cell, not the first span (a comment span after prose runs)
#2684 review F2: a cmd:-marked comment is exempt (the executors run what statusgen refuses)
#2684 review S1: the firstSpan port closes an N-tick fence on a single backtick (it drifts from statusgen's lift)
#3147: Lift runs the whole unwrapped cell again ("`false`: confirm" runs as the : no-op)
#3147: a prose-led first span is no longer refused (the executors run a file mention statusgen refuses)
#3147: a blank lift is no longer refused (sh -c "" exits 0)
#3147 A2: the : builtin is no longer a no-op
#3147 A2 over-refusal: a : followed by a real command is refused
#3147 A2: a cmd.exe REM remark is no longer a no-op
#3147 A2: a cmd.exe :: remark is no longer a no-op
#3147 A2: the no-op is judged on the first span, not the lift (a marked : runs)
#3147 A2: a row built without a cell no longer refuses a no-op
ported prose-led table drops an extension statusgen keeps
ported bare-word pattern drifts from statusgen
